messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Issue with meta/ms3.out/NA folder
parts:
Two possible issues:

f0=0
You probably need to change this ot f0=1. Note that in GGIR, and more generally in R, we count from one up as opposed to zero, common in some other programming environments.  So, first file is indexed with 1.

mode = c(1,2,5)
This would only work if mode =c(1,2, 3,4) has been run previously and the milestone data generated from that is still in the output folder. GGIR needs to run it's part 3 and 4, in order to be able to do part 5.

I hope this helps.
Cheers, Vincent

On Tuesday, September 21st, 2021 at 22:42, K B <kbro...@uw.edu> wrote:
I have 14 days of Actigraph data for 6 individuals and I've run the shell code below (with mode = c(1,2,5), do.report = c(2,5), and parts 3+ 4 commented out). I got all the results with no problems, and the QC files all say the the data looks good. But when I try to get the run the code with mode  = c(1,2,3,4,5), do.report = c(2,4,5), and parts 3 + 4 included to see the sleep visualization, I am getting an error that reads:

Warning in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :
  cannot open compressed file '/Users/kbrown/Desktop/TEDD Actigraph data/Output/output_Baseline/meta/ms3.out/NA', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

I'm not sure what to do about this error, even after reading the conversations where others have had a similar problem. I checked the ms1.out and ms2.out folders and there are .csv files there for all participants, but there is nothing in the ms3.out folder. I don't think we have any sleep log data, so I thought maybe that is causing the issue? Although in another conversation I read that I you do not need the sleep log data for part 4 to run. Any help on this would be greatly appreciated!!
